card.name: Students and classes in lesson plans
card.fires_on: The word students, or class and lesson words, in teaching materials and lesson plans, especially where the next word is likely to be about what students do.

modes.label: Students as subject
modes.description: The word students (or Students) as the doer in a lesson plan or assessment line.
modes.example: Overview of Lesson Plan: In this lesson,<< students>> evaluate current search procedures implemented to fight terrorism

modes.label: Lesson or class nouns
modes.description: Words like lesson, Lesson, class or classes in a teacher's description of a lesson or project.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about students and their schoolwork, such as students and assignments.
card.plain: It fires in teaching text when the talk is about students, a class or a lesson.
